column1: # Reviewed supplement: slurs the NWL2020 purge does not cover.
# One word per line: word, reason.
# Why a supplement is needed. The 2020 revision was written for a
# tournament lexicon, so it kept any word carrying a non-offensive
# sense somewhere: faggot survives as a bundle of sticks, fag as a
# cigarette, coon as a raccoon, negro as a Spanish colour word. That
# is the right call for competitive Scrabble and the wrong one for a
# game Bea plays, where the reading that lands is the only one that
# matters. The revision also predates transphobic slurs being a
# category anyone audited, so it covers none of them.
# Unlike nwl2020-purged.txt this list has no public source, so it is
# hand-curated and every entry carries its reason. It is held to the
# same bar as nwl2020-exclusions.tsv, just pointing the other way:
# a word is denied only when it has no neutral primary sense in
# ordinary modern English.
# Deliberately NOT here, because the neutral sense is the primary one:
#   lame, lamer  weak or unconvincing, and of an injured animal
#   deaf         a plain descriptive word, not a slur
#   moron, idiot fully generalised informal English; also common-pool
#                words, so denying them would move par (see the report)
#   queer        reclaimed, and the ordinary sense is "strange"
#   creole       a neutral linguistic and cultural term
#   dyke         an embankment, which is the primary reading
#   poof         a puff of smoke, or to vanish
#   nutter       mild informal British for an eccentric
#   pansies      flowers
#   dwarf        astronomy, botany, folklore
# The line between fag and poof, or coon and dyke, is which reading is
# primary in the lexicon this game actually ships (US ENABLE) and how
# severe the other reading is. That is a judgment call, and it is
# Antoine's to overturn by moving a line between this file and
# nwl2020-exclusions.tsv.
